results.name: static_program_ABI_and_import_review
results.detail: AST parse/compile and import/call inspection only; no module import, function invocation or data generation.

results.name: numeric_transcription_against_original
results.detail: Compared submitted coefficients and their evidence SEs directly to separately parsed Windows-1252 original export; compared residual scales, variances, correlation and Gamma dispersion.

results.name: demographic_counts_and_balanced_design
results.detail: Compared all 28 count/label cells to the original export and checked normalization and task row arithmetic; these are analytic sums, not realized samples.

results.name: random_effect_covariance_identity
results.detail: Analytically verified the standard-normal linear transformation has the requested covariance and the covariance is positive definite; no random effects were sampled.

results.name: Gamma_spline_softmax_and_design_algebra
results.detail: Verified Gamma normalized moment identities, full 16-term interaction ordering, reference-logit convention, and invented scalar/matrix numerical probes of spline and stable-softmax algebra. These probes do not invoke the generator or create any clinical table.

results.name: analytic_age_support_and_mixture
results.detail: Verified age support against task bounds and integrated the specified uniform demographic mixture analytically. No age observations were sampled and no coefficient was changed based on these moments.
